cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

mechanism: A directs an inspector's certification and recasts that very professional approval as structural support for the impossible plan.
confusable: Unlike ordinary persuasion about safety, the approval becomes an increasingly absurd part of what holds the landing up.
comparison: Inspector confidence supports visitors and inspectors, unlike weather caught before it falls.
seedUse: The seed already tells the inspector where to sign and makes the official's certainty serve A's scheme, enacting assumed higher rank.
